name: Rudi Lins
features: dark hair, lean face, reserved manner, slim build
bio: The quiet Vorarlberger who ran the Porsche Salzburg 908/02 through 1970 with Helmut Marko, third overall at Le Mans behind the two 917s and the class win with it. Stopped racing soon after to run his company, having beaten most of the works drivers on the way out.
